verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
lines: God is our refuge and strength,
a very present help in trouble.

verses.text: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
lines: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes,
though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

verses.text: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling.
lines: though its waters roar and are troubled,
though the mountains tremble with their swelling.

verses.text: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
lines: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad,
the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

verses.text: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
lines: God is within her. She shall not be moved.
God will help her at dawn.

verses.text: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
lines: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved.
He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

verses.text: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
lines: Yahweh of Armies is with us.
The God of Jacob is our refuge.

verses.text: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
lines: Come, see Yahweh’s works,
what desolations he has made in the earth.

verses.text: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
lines: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth.
He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear.
He burns the chariots in the fire.

verses.text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
lines: “Be still, and know that I am God.
I will be exalted among the nations.
I will be exalted in the earth.”

verses.text: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
lines: Yahweh of Armies is with us.
The God of Jacob is our refuge.
